definitions.gloss: to rise in status; to climb the social ladder; to make it big
definitions.explanation: to rise from a humble position to a high social or economic status

examples.japanese: ⟦{貧|まず}しい→貧しい：02349_mazushii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{成|な}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: He rose from a poor family.

examples.japanese: {成|な}り{上|あ}がり⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: To be called a parvenu/nouveau riche.

examples.japanese: {一代|いちだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{財|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}いて→築く：02046_kizuku⟧{成|な}り{上|あ}がった⟦{実業家|じつぎょうか}→実業家：12294_jitsugyouka⟧。
examples.english: A businessman who built his fortune and rose to prominence in a single generation.

notes:
USAGE:
- {成|な}り{上|あ}がる (to rise in status)
- {成|な}り{上|あ}がり⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (parvenu, upstart, nouveau riche)
Often carries a slightly negative connotation, implying someone who has risen quickly but may lack the refinement or grace associated with established wealth/status. Similar to 'upstart' or 'nouveau riche' in English.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to advance in career - neutral)
- ⟦{立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}→立身出世：23098_risshinshusse⟧ (rising in the world)
